content.question: When did you move to your neighborhood? Why did you choose to live there?
When was the last time you were invited to visit a neighbor's house?
What are some ways to get to know your neighbors better?

Question 8: How much does it cost to watch a movie at your theater?

Question 9: It seems like we could afford some time to visit on the 15th of July. What movie is scheduled to be played on that day?

Question 10: My family loves adventure movies. What movies do you recommend for people like us?

parts.label: Topic Preparation
parts.instruction: Think about your answers to the following questions. You will discuss these topics in the next class. Take 60 seconds to prepare each one.
questions: Do you think open office spaces or private offices are better for employee productivity? Why?
Do you think that employee satisfaction is vital to a company’s success? Give reasons for your opinion.
Do you think students learn better through online or in-person classes? Give reasons for your preference.
